question: Should OpenClaw accept this opt-in Discord source-message subagent progress feature, including channels.discord.subagentProgress and messageId on subagent hook requester metadata, once the branch is rebased cleanly?
rationale: The code path is plausibly correct and proof-backed, but the new operator/config and hook metadata surface is a product/API commitment that automation should not approve by itself.

options.title: Accept after clean rebase
options.body: Keep the default-off Discord progress feature and require a conflict-free refresh that preserves current main behavior before merge.

options.title: Narrow the surface
options.body: Ask the author to keep more of the behavior Discord-internal if maintainers do not want the hook/config surface to become public API yet.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Close or pause the PR if Discord-only progress is not a current product priority compared with broader cross-channel subagent liveness work.

recommendation.title: Accept after clean rebase
recommendation.body: Keep the default-off Discord progress feature and require a conflict-free refresh that preserves current main behavior before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The shallow current-main history points to Peter on the overlapping agent/Discord files, so he is the best available maintainer-side decision owner from the inspected history.
